{{Quote|I'm okay where I am, thanks. I meant that I like living with the Vevut family.|[[Mirta Gev]]|<ref name="Sacrifice" />}}
Located in [[Mandalore/Legends|Mandalore's]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Keldabe/Legends|Keldabe]], '''Novoc Vevut's home''' served as both the residence for the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Clan Vevut|Vevut clan]], and the workshop for [[Novoc Vevut]]'s [[Blaster/Legends|weapon]] manufacturing and repair business. Attached to the workshop, the home featured a sizable yard, where Vevut could occasionally be found machining parts for weapons at a grinding bench. Though Vevut had little concern for leaving metal shavings in the yard, visitors to the home were expected to remove their [[Boot/Legends|boots]] upon entering,<ref name="Sacrifice" /> a common courtesy in the Mandalorian culture.<ref name="TMPaC">{{InsiderCite|86|The Mandalorians: People and Culture}}</ref>

By the start of the [[Second Galactic Civil War]], the Keldabe home housed Novoc Vevut and his [[Gai bal manda|adopted]] son, [[Ghes Orade]]. However, in the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[40 ABY/Legends|40 ABY]], Vevut's home also became the residence of [[Mirta Gev]], the granddaughter of [[Mandalore (title)/Legends|''Mand'alor'']] [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]] and Orade's girlfriend,<ref name="Sacrifice" /> and later, [[Marriage/Legends|wife]]. Following the [[Wedding of Ghes Orade and Mirta Gev|marriage]] of Orade and Gev in early [[41 ABY]], a large celebratory [[Foodstuff/Legends|feast]] was held at the Vevut home.<ref name="Revelation">''[[Legacy of the Force: Revelation]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Novoc Vevut's home first appeared in ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[canon]] in the ''[[Star Wars: Legacy of the Force]]'' novel, ''[[Legacy of the Force: Sacrifice]]'', written by [[Author/Legends|author]] [[Karen Traviss]] and published [[May 29]], [[2007]]. Traviss used the location again in her subsequent entry in the ''Legacy of the Force'' series, ''[[Legacy of the Force: Revelation]]'', published the following year on [[February 26]], [[2008]].
